vulnerable_code:
class SupportAgentChannel < ApplicationCable::Channel
  def subscribed
    # Subscribes to customer queue stream without validating agent credentials
    stream_from "support_queue_#{params[:queue_code]}"
  end
end
diagnosis: The SupportAgentChannel allows subscribers to connect to any support queue by specifying queue_code. Standard end-users can subscribe to executive or VIP customer support queues to inspect unresolved customer escalations and internal staff notes.
corrected_code:
class SupportAgentChannel < ApplicationCable::Channel
  def subscribed
    reject unless current_user.support_agent? && current_user.assigned_queue?(params[:queue_code])

    stream_from "support_queue_#{params[:queue_code]}"
  end
end
